O.outcome_detail: PEG Transfer performance score at T2 and T3

cells.quote: For the performance score of the exercise PEG transfer, we could detect a significant difference at test time T2 and T3. The subjects in the group with straight instruments performed better (224.1 ± 8.6 vs. 190.1 ± 54.1, p = 0.024 and 233.4 ± 21.1 vs. 208.3 ± 28.6, p = 0.028).
cells.note: Novices completed five training sessions within two weeks; the quoted results compare the randomized 2D straight- and curved-instrument groups.

O.outcome_detail: Intracorporeal Suture performance score at T5

cells.quote: The Intracorporeal Suture exercise showed better performance in the straight instrument group at several test time points, including T5 (305 ± 100.5 vs. 147.3 ± 191.5, p = 0.012), as well as fewer errors (0.76 ± 2.09 vs. 0.97 ± 1.03, p = 0.033).
